                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper04" title="发布于 2025-12-02 18:44">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAF快速入门（4）多Agent工作流编排</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202184235358-1237594737.png" alt="MAF快速入门（4）多Agent工作流编排" class="desc_img">
        本文介绍了如何使用MAF框架完成基本的多Agent工作流编排，并给出了两个常用的编排案例：移交编排 和 顺序编排，最后介绍了如何借助结合流式执行 和 内置事件 完成工作流的进度监控。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper03" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们学习了MAF中如何持久化聊天记录到关系型数据库<span>。这一篇，我们来学习一下工作流编排。不知大家是否记得，我们在之前用Semantic Kernel学习过多Agent编排的一些知识，例如顺序，并发，移交等模式仍然历历在目。那么，今天，我们用MAF的工作流编排来实现一下，看看有什么不一样。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>多Agent编排</strong></h1>
<p><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>传统的单代理系统在处理复杂多面任务的能力方面受到限制。 通过协调多个代理，每个代理都有专门的技能或角色，我们可以创建更可靠、更自适应且能够协作解决实际问题的系统。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">目前，MAF支持以下编排模式，和SK几乎一致：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202183517278-1472580245.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>今天，我们用MAF来实践一下顺序编排 和 移交编排 两个最常用的模式。</p>
<p>顺序编排的典型案例如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202183534317-2067733443.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">移交编排的典型案例如下图所示：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202183545242-1966637477.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1><strong>准备工作</strong></h1>
<p><span>在今天的这个案例中，我们创建了一个.NET控制台应用程序，安装了以下NuGet包：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Agents.AI.Workflows</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>我们的配置文件中定义了LLM API的信息：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>{
  "OpenAI": {
    "EndPoint": "https://api.siliconflow.cn",
    "ApiKey": "******************************",
    "ModelId": "Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct"
  }
}</pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>这里我们使用 SiliconCloud 提供<span><span>的<span><span>&nbsp;Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct&nbsp;<span><span>模型，你<span><span>可以通过这个URL注册账号：<span><span><a href="https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW</a><span>&nbsp;获取大量免费的Token来进行本次实验。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>然后，我们将配置文件中的API信息读取出来：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
    .AddJsonFile($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appsettings.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, optional: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>, reloadOnChange: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> openAIProvider = config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).Get&lt;OpenAIProvider&gt;();</pre>
</div>
<h1><span>实现移交编排</span></h1>
<p><span><span>首先，我们创建一个ChatClient供后续使用：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Step1. Create one ChatClient</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> chatClient = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIClient(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(openAIProvider.ApiKey),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(openAIProvider.Endpoint) })
    .GetChatClient(openAIProvider.ModelId);</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>然后，我们定义一个FunctionAgentFactory，封装我们需要编排的几个Agent：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionAgentFactory
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent CreateTriageAgent(ChatClient client)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.CreateAIAgent(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You determine which agent to use based on the user's homework question. ALWAYS handoff to another agent.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">triage_agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Routes messages to the appropriate specialist agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent CreateHistoryTutorAgent(ChatClient client)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.CreateAIAgent(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You provide assistance with historical queries. Explain important events and context clearly. Please only respond about history.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">history_tutor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Specialist agent for historical questions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent CreateMathTutorAgent(ChatClient client)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.CreateAIAgent(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You provide help with math problems. Explain your reasoning at each step and include examples. Please only respond about math.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">math_tutor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Specialist agent for mathematical questions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>基于AgentFactory依次创建编排Agent，历史Agent 和 数学Agent：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> triageAgent =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionAgentFactory.CreateTriageAgent(chatClient);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> historyTutor =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionAgentFactory.CreateHistoryTutorAgent(chatClient);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> mathTutor = FunctionAgentFactory.CreateMathTutorAgent(chatClient);</pre>
</div>
<p>基于上面的3个Agent可以快速创建一个移交编排Workflow：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> workflow =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentWorkflowBuilder.CreateHandoffBuilderWith(triageAgent)
    .WithHandoffs(triageAgent, [mathTutor, historyTutor]) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Triage can route to either specialist</span>
    .WithHandoffs([mathTutor, historyTutor], triageAgent) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Math or History tutor can return to triage</span>
    .Build();</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>怎么样，是不是很简单？</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>下面，我们进行一个多轮对话测试：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>List&lt;ChatMessage&gt; messages = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> userInput = Console.ReadLine()!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    messages.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(ChatRole.User, userInput));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Execute workflow and process events</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> workflow.AsAgent().RunAsync(messages);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent: {response}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Add new messages to conversation history</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    messages.AddRange(response.Messages);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>这里我们使用了Workflow as Agent的方式，即将工作流转换为一个独立的Agent来调用。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>测试结果如下图所示：</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202183813564-1267677622.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span>可以看到，编排Agent根据用户的输入将请求转给了对应的数学话题Agent 和 历史话题Agent，进而使用户获得正确的回答。</span></p>
<h1><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-bottom: 16px;margin-top: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">实现顺序编排</span></h1>
<p><span><span>首先，创建一个ChatClient，同上。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>然后，封装一个AgentFactory来定义我们用到的3个Agent：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>Analyst 需求分析</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>Writer 文案写手</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>Editor 文案审稿人/编辑</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionAgentFactory
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent CreateAnalystAgent(ChatClient client)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.CreateAIAgent(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                You are a marketing analyst. Given a product description, identify:
                </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Key features
                </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Target audience
                </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Unique selling points
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Analyst</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">An agent that extracts key concepts from a product description.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent CreatWriterAgent(ChatClient client)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.CreateAIAgent(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                You are a marketing copywriter. Given a block of text describing features, audience, and USPs,
                compose a compelling marketing copy (like a newsletter section) that highlights these points.
                Output should be </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">short</span> (around <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">150</span> words), output just the copy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a single text block.
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CopyWriter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">An agent that writes a marketing copy based on the extracted concepts.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgent CreateEditorAgent(ChatClient client)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.CreateAIAgent(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                You are an editor. Given the draft copy, correct grammar, improve clarity, ensure consistent tone,
                give format and make it polished. Output the final improved copy </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a single text block.
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Editor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">An agent that formats and proofreads the marketing copy.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>基于这几个Agent我们快速定一个顺序工作流：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> analyst =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionAgentFactory.CreateAnalystAgent(chatClient);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> writer =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionAgentFactory.CreatWriterAgent(chatClient);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> editor =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionAgentFactory.CreateEditorAgent(chatClient);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Workflow: Analyst -&gt; Writer -&gt; Editor</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> workflow =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentWorkflowBuilder.BuildSequential(
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content-team-workflow</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
  [analyst, writer, editor]);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>快速运行，直接得到答案：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> userMessage = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Please help to introduce our new product: An eco-friendly stainless steel water bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.Write($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User: {userMessage}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Execute the workflow via RunAsync</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> workflow.AsAgent().RunAsync(userMessage);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent: {response}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>这里用户给的任务是：<span>"Please help to introduce our new product: An eco-friendly stainless steel water bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours."</span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="3 3 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em; margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,null,&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:null},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span data-pm-slice="3 3 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;},\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;p\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;line-height: 1.75em; margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;},\&quot;para\&quot;,null,\&quot;node\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;span\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:null},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span>假设客户公司有一个新产品：一个环保的不锈钢水瓶，可以让饮料保持24小时的低温<span><span>，需要帮忙创作一个广告文案。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>我们仍然将其转换为Agent来执行，获取结果下图所示：</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202183919923-907321420.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<div>可以看到，它将最后审核校对的最终版内容输出给了我们。</div>
<div>
<h1><span><span>借助事件机制监控</span></span></h1>
<p><span><span>假设我们想要获取每个步骤对应Agent的输出内容，进而实现一定程度的监控。那么，同步执行就不合适了，这时我们就需要用到工作流的事件机制 结合 流式执行获取事件流 来实现。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>MAF的工作流事件机制内置了一些系统事件，例如：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>AgentRunUpdatedEvent&nbsp;</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>ExecutorCompletedEvent 执行器完成事件，例如Workflow中的某个Agent完成了任务，准备转到下个Agent执行。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>WorkflowOutputEvent 整个工作流已完成任务处理准备进行最终输出。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>这里我们使用MAF中的StreamAsync 和 WatchStreamAsync，其主要流程如下图所示：</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202183945528-779037629.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span>下面我们直接看代码：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (StreamingRun run = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InProcessExecution.StreamAsync(workflow, userMessage))
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> run.TrySendMessageAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> TurnToken(emitEvents: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Enable event emitting</span>
    Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Process Tracking</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;ChatMessage&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> stageOutput = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringBuilder();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> stepNumber = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (WorkflowEvent evt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run.WatchStreamAsync())
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (evt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentRunUpdateEvent updatedEvent)
        {
            stageOutput.Append($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{updatedEvent.Data} </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (evt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecutorCompletedEvent completedEvent)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (stageOutput.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Step {stepNumber}: {completedEvent.ExecutorId}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Output: {stageOutput.ToString()}\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                stepNumber</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                stageOutput.Clear();
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (evt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WorkflowOutputEvent endEvent)
        {
            result </span>= (List&lt;ChatMessage&gt;)endEvent.Data!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Display final result and skip user message</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> message <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> result.Skip(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent: {message.Text}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\nTask Finished!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>最终，输出的结果如下所示：</span></span></p>
<p><strong>Step1: Analyst</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202184032859-40327449.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><strong>Step2 ~3: Writer &amp; Editor</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202184042241-1807150373.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><strong>最终输出的内容</strong>：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251202184050256-321635354.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span>由上图可以看出，如果我们需要对于Workflow进行进度监控，使用流式执行 并 监听内置事件 完全可以实现这个目的。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>其他更多的内置工作流事件如下代码示例所示：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行工作流并监听所有事件</span>
Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🚀 开始执行工作流 (流式模式)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> input = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello Workflow Events!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📥 输入: \"{input}\"\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 启动流式执行</span>
StreamingRun run = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InProcessExecution.StreamAsync(simpleWorkflow, input);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📡 开始监听事件流...\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">─</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> eventCount = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 订阅事件流</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (WorkflowEvent evt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run.WatchStreamAsync())
{
    eventCount</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 显示事件的完整信息</span>
    Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n🔔 事件 #{eventCount}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   类型: {evt.GetType().Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据事件类型显示详细信息
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> switch (evt)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     case WorkflowStartedEvent:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   说明: 工作流开始执行");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         break;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     case ExecutorInvokedEvent invokedEvent:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   Executor: {invokedEvent.ExecutorId}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   说明: Executor 开始执行");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   输入: {invokedEvent.Data}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         break;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     case ExecutorCompletedEvent completedEvent:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   Executor: {completedEvent.ExecutorId}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   说明: Executor 执行完成");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   输出: {completedEvent.Data}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         break;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     case SuperStepCompletedEvent stepEvent:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   SuperStep: #{stepEvent.StepNumber}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   说明: 执行步骤完成");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         break;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     case WorkflowOutputEvent outputEvent:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   来源: {outputEvent.SourceId}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   说明: 工作流产生输出");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   结果: {outputEvent.Data}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         break;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     default:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         Console.WriteLine($"   数据: {evt.Data}");
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">         break;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> }</span>
    Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">─</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
}
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n✅ 工作流执行完成，共产生 {eventCount} 个事件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h1><span>小结</span></h1>
<p>本文介绍了如何使用MAF框架完成基本的多Agent工作流编排，并给出了两个常用的编排案例：移交编排 和 顺序编排，最后介绍了如何借助结合流式执行 和 内置事件 完成工作流的进度监控。</p>
<p>下一篇，我们将继续MAF的学习。</p>
<h1><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">示例源码</span></h1>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">GitHub:&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/EdisonTalk/MAFD" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/EdisonTalk/MAFD</a></span></p>
